name: Áeda
text: Áeda is a MacKillop cross-reference pointing to the Áedán headword. MacKillop reads the form as a parallel Gaelic name form attached to the same bearer. The principal record of the common Gaelic saint-name tradition sits under the Áedán headword.

attributes.attribute: Parallel Gaelic name form; pointer to Áedán headword
